taxonomy.description: Establish the state at the cut-off from effective acts, chronology and operative conditions.
Determine what a document or actor can establish, using the file’s own authority and capacity terms.
Resolve distinguishable named entities from explicit links and withhold unsupported mergers.
Combine dependent statements from different Sources into one licensed decision.
Attach every necessary member of an independently verified sufficient proof to the same edge.
Reconcile or withhold competing relationship assertions according to their scope, independence and authority.
Distinguish a supported negative or positive from an underdetermined named assertion.
Distinguish independent origins, quoted material and copied or administratively relayed evidence.
Recognise the scope and provenance of co-present drafts, partial amendments, and corrections.
Recover every supported relationship, including ordinary invariant edges across a mixed file.
Preserve relevant facts embedded in routine material and reject unsupported role cues. Volume is descriptive absent a matched workload control.
Test a specified interaction only when simpler contrasts explain what each axis contributes.
Vary presentation order with original chronology and the document bytes held fixed.
Represent received, copied or missing artifacts in the supplied file. Score only the consequences for supported graph claims.
Find, retrieve or request a Source outside the supplied file.
Acquire, OCR or recover physical text. A stipulated missing field in text can test reasoning within the supplied bundle.

families.title: Scoped trust amendment
families.name: Alder Fold Trust
families.intended_difficulty: Changing only the amendment's provision locator switches which earlier beneficiary assertion survives without changing the replacement beneficiary, trust or unaffected relationships. Reject the design if either branch is ambiguous, has a wider effect, or supports the replacement without the planned cross-Source link.
incidental_challenges: The principal instrument supplies separate office and beneficiary provisions. The signed variation has its own effective date.
matched_controls: D0 and D1 change only the operative provision locator. The earlier survivor changes, the replacement and unaffected relationships persist, and the saved keys attach joint scope proof to each current beneficiary.
Grouped proof was independently verified in the closing audit.
known_shortcuts_and_limits: Individual fact-level deletions remain incomplete. Reading the locator alone can reproduce the graph without demonstrating the full intended reasoning.
The invariant edges cover trust relationships. Unrelated kinship remains outside this comparison.

families.title: Complete-record identity collision
families.name: Park will planning
families.intended_difficulty: Creating a collision in one populated display field leaves the complete named graph and valid evidence routes invariant when stable references and explicit identity links remain fixed. Reject the design if the field has authority to alter the mapping, the alternative label is not credible, or the proposed identity link is dispensable.
incidental_challenges: The working index uses ancillary display forms for distinct people. The authoritative reconciliation gives complete identities and stable references.
matched_controls: F0 and F1 change only one populated display label. Both complete named graphs and their separately attached proof sets remain invariant.
Withholding an exact identity entry defeated its dependent edge in the masked review.
known_shortcuts_and_limits: Positional pairing can reproduce the graph.

The original isolated excerpt reader entered a different structured surname despite identifying the correct person in the explanation. The independent identical-packet repeat returned the correct surname.
The result is bounded to this display-label collision.

B covers incomplete speaker attribution and F covers a populated display-label collision with complete identity records. F permits a positional shortcut. Broader identity collisions and interacting information gaps remain open.
